title: Junior Selection Committee Minutes Released
indian_angle: This update provides transparency on the selection process for India's promising junior badminton players.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has published the minutes from its recent Junior Selection Committee meeting, detailing decisions and discussions regarding player selections.

title: BAI Implements New Service Height Measuring Device Policy
indian_angle: The new policy ensures consistent application of service rules across domestic tournaments, affecting Indian players.
summary: BAI has issued guidelines for the transfer and use of the Service Height Measuring Device (SHMD) to standardize officiating practices in national events.

title: BAI Establishes New Athletes Committee
indian_angle: The formation of this committee empowers Indian athletes with a direct voice in the governance and development of badminton in the country.
summary: The Badminton Association of India announced the formation of its new Athletes Committee, aimed at giving players a greater role in decision-making processes.

title: National Coaching Camp for World Junior Championships Kicks Off in Guwahati
indian_angle: This camp is crucial for preparing India's top junior talents for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships, aiming for international success.
summary: India's junior badminton squad has gathered at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati for an intensive coaching camp ahead of the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: Applications Open for Players of Outstanding Merit
indian_angle: This initiative provides a pathway for exceptional Indian badminton players to receive recognition and support from the national body.
summary: BAI has invited applications from players demonstrating outstanding merit, offering opportunities for special consideration and support within the national badminton framework.

title: BAI Advanced Coaches Course Held in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: The course aims to elevate the coaching standards across India, directly benefiting the development of future Indian badminton stars.
summary: The Badminton Association of India successfully conducted its Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course across two centers, Guwahati and Raipur, enhancing coaching expertise nationwide.
